correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md proves exact Lyapunov sum C=2h(I-(I-hA)^2)^(-1) for stable symmetric SPD A, hence C^(-1)=A-hA^2/2. Range C>=2hI and all symmetric square roots K^2=I-2hC^(-1) are classified by orthogonal projectors on equal-eigenvalue spaces, yielding the complete Grassmannian fiber and uniqueness iff C=2hI. Scalar covariance for nonscalar A forces precisely two eigenvalues a<b with h=2/(a+b), also the unique spectral-radius optimal step; B^2=q^2 I gives every Gaussian one-time marginal from zero. Two distinct stable covariance inverses recover A by eliminating A^2. The proof excludes paths/joint laws and finite-sample inference. Exact independent diagonal rational checks confirmed C=4I/3 for A=diag(1,3), h=1/2 and recovery from h=1/5.
